cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. What do you gain if your cousin wins the club election?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And which of your proposals becomes easier to approve?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I know which square of competence we're discussing.

mechanism: A turns its former committee pupil vague support for a rival into named success criteria, personal gain and an explicit comparison with A competing proposal.
confusable: Not merely discovering a hidden policy preference: A asks how that payoff places A relative to the rival.
comparison: Picnic evaluation and reelection versus vote preference tied to personal parking cost.
seedUse: D198 cousin president/competence/car park; add A competing roof proposal and B concrete benefit; S05 taught reading proposals.
